# Watchlist Monitor

## Purpose
- Review a user's watchlist and flag which names deserve attention.

## What the user provides
- A comma-separated list of tickers
- Optional focus: buy candidates, risk alerts, or earnings plays

## What the AI would analyze
- Recent news and catalysts
- Technical context
- Valuation and fundamentals
- Risk/reward and timing

## Output
- Top 3-5 names to watch
- Which names are becoming more attractive
- Which names look risky or overextended
- Suggested next actions

## Why it fits
- Practical and lightweight
- Works as a daily research assistant
- Well suited to users who already maintain a watchlist
